resources.string: Shows the docking stations of the bike-share systems of Barcelona (Bicing) and Madrid (BiciMAD) on the map. It downloads one small data file from your map server (the same one as the maps); your position is never sent.

While a station card is open, asks that system\'s public data feed how many bikes and free docks it has, at most once every 30 seconds. This contacts a third-party server (barcelona.publicbikesystem.net or madrid.publicbikesystem.net), which can see your IP address and that you look at its system, but not which station. Off by default.
Station data: Bicing, Ajuntament de Barcelona (Open Data BCN, CC BY 4.0); BiciMAD, Empresa Municipal de Transportes de Madrid (datos.madrid.es, CC BY 4.0).
The number of docks is from the data file. Whether a bike is available is only known if you turn on live availability in Settings.
